defs.def: to be likely to do sth or to happen in a particular way because this is what often or usually happens 往往会；常常就

ex.s: We tend to forget that sea level is a product of technically and culturally determined assumptions.
ex.t: 我们往往忘记，海平面是技术性和文化性预设共同的产物。

ex.s: Even when I’m planning classes, I tend to think about how I can bring in my hobbies.
ex.t: 即使在我备课的时候，我也倾向于想着怎么把我的爱好带进去。

ex.s: Moreover, we humans tend to assume that positive reviews might be fake.
ex.t: 此外，我们人类倾向于认为正面评价可能是假的。

ex.s: A long, negative review of a hotel, complete with lots of information, tended to convince participants.
ex.t: 一条信息详尽的冗长负面酒店评论，往往能说服参与者。

ex.s: A lengthy, positive review, on the other hand, was regarded as suspicious, and participants tended to trust writers that kept their glowing reviews short.
ex.t: 另一方面，冗长的正面评论被视为可疑，参与者往往更信任那些把好评写得简短的作者。

ex.s: Azimi says study participants tended not to trust reviews where the writers expressed their feelings in a big way.
ex.t: Azimi说，研究参与者往往不信任那些作者大肆抒发感情的评论。

ex.s: Biodiversity tends to be overlooked.
ex.t: 生物多样性往往被忽视。

ex.s: Instead, people with stronger moral character tend to experience greater meaning in life and happiness.
ex.t: 相反，道德品格更强的人往往在生命意义和幸福上体验更深。

ex.s: Tending to plants is an exercise in patience and learning.
ex.t: 照料植物是耐心与学习的一种修炼。

ex.s: The West tends to overvalue optimism.
ex.t: 西方倾向于过度评价乐观主义.

ex.s: However, when a cat is looking for affection, they tend to produce stretched and soft meows.
ex.t: 然而，当猫在寻求亲近时，它们往往发出拉长的、轻柔的喵叫。

ex.s: Studies have shown that it calculates the effort required for actions and tends to stop us from squandering vital resources on fruitless efforts, like walking over 30 km for a handful of berries.
ex.t: 研究表明，它会计算行动所需的努力，并倾向于阻止我们把重要资源浪费在无果的努力上，比如走30多公里只为摘一把浆果。

ex.s: Hedgehog thinkers tend to answer yes. ___35___ And they are usually very credible in doing so.
ex.t: 刺猬型思考者倾向于回答是的。___35___而且他们在这样做时通常很有说服力。

ex.s: Some people will tend to overestimate, and some to underestimate.
ex.t: 有些人倾向于高估，有些人倾向于低估。

ex.s: If people are similar and tend to make the same errors, then their errors won’t cancel each other out.
ex.t: 如果人们相似且容易犯同样的错误，那么他们的错误就不会相互抵消。

ex.s: Did they tend to go with those most confident about their estimates?
ex.t: 他们是否倾向于跟随那些对自己的估计最有信心的人？

ex.s: Although landscapes in the Midwest tend to be quite similar, either farm fields or highways, sometimes I find distinctive character in the hills or lakes.
ex.t: 尽管中西部的风景往往很相似，要么农田要么公路，我有时还是在山丘或湖泊中发现独特个性。

ex.s: Humans tend to make long-term sacrifices.
ex.t: 人类往往做出长期的牺牲.

ex.s: Cattle tend to be kept in remote places and their value has risen, making them appealing targets.
ex.t: 牛往往被养在偏远地区，其价值上升，成了诱人的目标。

ex.s: Even soccer fans tend to have a seat each; gone are the days of thousands standing to watch the match.
ex.t: 就连足球迷也倾向于每人有一个座位；成千上万人站着观看比赛的日子一去不复返了。

ex.s: With our tender, hopeful skin, that is where we begin.
ex.t: 带着我们柔嫩、充满希望的皮肤，那是我们开始的地方。

ex.s: While I tend to buy a lot of books, these three were given to me as gifs, which might add to the meaning I attach to them.
ex.t: 虽然我往往买很多书，但这三本是作为礼物送给我的，这或许增加了我对它们的情感分量。

ex.s: Higher-income parents tended to have children play with puzzles more frequently, and both boys and girls who played with puzzles had better spatial skills.
ex.t: 高收入父母更常让孩子玩拼图，而玩拼图的男孩女孩空间能力都更好。

ex.s: However, boys tended to play with more complex puzzles than girls, and the parents of boys provided more spatial language and were more active during puzzle play than parents of girls.
ex.t: 然而，男孩往往比女孩玩更复杂的拼图，男孩的父母提供更多空间语言，并在拼图游戏中比女孩的父母更积极。

ex.s: They tend to talk less during the game.
ex.t: 他们往往在比赛中少说话.

ex.s: Children Tend to Learn Determination from Father
ex.t: 儿童向父亲学习决心

ex.s: People tend to focus on the first factor.
ex.t: 人们倾向于关注第一因素.

ex.s: Scientists tend to be curious and ambitious.
ex.t: 科学家往往既好奇又有抱负。

ex.s: The genius tends to get things done creatively.
ex.t: 天才往往会创造性地完成事情.

ex.s: People who regularly practise positive thinking tend to solve problems more effectively.
ex.t: 经常进行积极思考的人往往会更有效地解决问题。

ex.s: They tend to believe in themselves and in what they do.
ex.t: 他们往往相信自己以及自己所做的事。

ex.s: Pessimists, on the contrary, tend to perceive problems as a source of additional stress.
ex.t: 相反，悲观主义者倾向于把问题视为额外压力的来源。

ex.s: They tended to be more adaptable.
ex.t: 他们往往更具适应性。

ex.s: Women tended to be more sociable.
ex.t: 女性往往更善于社交。

ex.s: Jenn Berman, author of The A to Z Guide to Raising Happy and Confident Kids, says, "We've gone to the opposite extreme of a few decades ago when parents tended to be more strict." By giving kids a lot of praise, parents think they're building their children's confidence, when, in fact, it may be just the opposite.
ex.t: 《培养快乐自信孩子的A到Z指南》作者詹·贝尔曼说：“我们走向了几十年前的反面，那时父母往往更严格。”通过给孩子大量表扬，父母以为在建立孩子的自信，而事实上可能恰恰相反。

ex.s: B．Those who tend to think back can hardly go ahead．
ex.t: B．那些倾向于回想的人几乎无法前进。

ex.s: People tend to lake pride in keeping everything in their street fresh and inviting.
ex.t: 人们往往以让街道上一切保持清新、诱人为荣。

ex.s: C． People tend to be blind to the beauty around them．
ex.t: C．人们往往对他们身边的美视而不见。

ex.s: D． People tend to educate teenagers at a museum．
ex.t: D．人倾向于在博物馆教育青少年。

ex.s: The writing in magazines also tends to be easy to read, especially if it is a children's publication.
ex.t: 杂志的写作也往往易读，尤其是儿童刊物。

ex.s: They tend to do things that excite them.
ex.t: 他们往往做一些让他们兴奋的事.

ex.s: Last October , while tending her garden in Mora , Sweden , Lena Pahlsson pulled out a handful of small   56  (carrot) and was about to throw them away.
ex.t: 去年十月，在瑞典莫拉打理花园时，莉娜·帕尔松拔出一把小胡萝卜，正要扔掉。

ex.s: Another nice thing is that you learn both new words and    64   (they)use unconsciously, meaning that you will tend to use the words    65   (learn)this way in conversations almost automatically.
ex.t: 另一件好事是，你无意中同时学到了新词和它们的____64____（they）用法，意味着你会倾向于在对话中几乎自动地使用这样____65____（learn）的词。

defs.def: to take a particular direction or often have a particular quality 趋向；走向；倾向；趋于

ex.s: People with more consistent stories tend to have a stronger sense of identity, and they feel their life has more meaning, direction and sense of purpose.
ex.t: 拥有更连贯人生故事的人，往往有更强的身份感，并觉得自己的生活更有意义、方向和目标感。

ex.s: Although parks of all sizes and types exist at any level, the national parks, in particular, tend ____41____ (catch) our attention because of their large size and variety.
ex.t: 虽然各级都有各种规模和类型的公园,但国家公园由于其____41____规模大,种类繁多,尤其引起我们的注意。

ex.s: I tend to travel with a few of my friends to state parks or to the countryside to go on adventures and take photos along the way.
ex.t: 我倾向于和几个朋友去州立公园或乡村冒险，沿途拍照。

ex.s: Often due to various pressures, we tend to ignore our health. ____35____ It is the fitness level of our body that helps us fight these diseases.
ex.t: 往往由于各种压力，我们倾向于忽视我们的健康。____35____正是我们身体的健康水平帮助我们抵抗这些疾病。

defs.def: to care for sb/sth 照料；照管；护理

ex.s: The specialists mentioned in Paragraph 3 tend to       .
ex.t: 第3段提到的专家倾向于.。

ex.s: Just as importantly, we tend to associate air with health care.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 同样重要的是，我们倾向于把空气与健康护理联系起来。

ex.s: It might not be real because social media doesn't present 6_________, and people tend to 7_________.
ex.t: 可能不是真的,因为社交媒体不提供6         ,人们倾向于7         .

defs.def: to serve customers in a store, bar, etc. 招待，侍候，照顾，照料（商店、酒吧等的顾客）

ex.s: On social media sites, people tend to post only positive updates that make them appear happy and friendly.
ex.t: 在社交媒体网站上，人们倾向于只发布让自己显得快乐友善的积极动态。

ex.s: And if you're in any doubt about this, take a moment to reflect on this line from The Secret Garden: "Where you tend a rose...
ex.t: 如果你对此有任何疑问,请花点时间从"秘密花园"中反省一下:"你在那里摆放一朵玫瑰......

ex.s: Filled with anger, you tend to say whatever comes to your mind.
ex.t: 充满愤怒时，你倾向于想到什么说什么。

ex.s: Outbreaks tend to occur in tropical regions of subSaharan Africa, the largest to date being the 2013–2016 epidemic in West Africa, which infected 28,616 people and claimed 11,310 lives.
ex.t: 撒哈拉以南非洲的热带地区往往发生疫情,迄今最大的疫情是2013-2016年西非的流行病,该流行病感染了28 616人,造成11 310人死亡。
